name: Honeywell Technologies
business_summary: Honeywell Technologies (formerly Honeywell International Inc.) is now a pure-play automation company following the completion of a three-way separation: Solstice Advanced Materials (SOLS) spun off October 2025, and Honeywell Aerospace (HONA) spun off June 29, 2026, accompanied by a 1-for-2 reverse stock split (~317M shares outstanding post-split). The remaining company operates three segments: Building Automation (fire, building products, building solutions/services), Industrial Automation (sensing, safety, warehouse/workflow, smart energy/thermal solutions), and Process Automation and Technology (UOP licensing/catalysts, boosted by the July 2026 Johnson Matthey Catalyst Technologies acquisition, plus process control and measurement). GAAP historicals through Q2 2026 remain consolidated including Aerospace; discontinued-operations restatement begins with the Q3 2026 10-Q. Founded 1885 (formerly AlliedSignal), headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina.
